name: cms
note: CMS Phase-2 step3 with HGCal/TICL and the tracker: hgcal.json and tracker.json joined. HGCalNanoAOD's GeneralTrack has the rows of Tracks (both are generalTracks in order): it is checked and folded into Tracks, which takes over its HGCal entry point (used where a TICL candidate has no trackster), so candidate -> track and track <-> truth relations reach Tracks. Truth particles are drawn as helices; only in-time pile-up is kept: particles of bunch crossing 0 and the vertices they are produced in or decay at (at PU200: 105k of 720k particles, 63k of 425k vertices per event). Domains: Tracker and HGCal, regions from the hits of the ttbar samples (tracker hits r <= 110 cm, |z| <= 268 cm; HGCal hits r <= 257 cm, 322 <= |z| <= 513 cm). Field: 3.8 T to |z| = 320 cm, where a helix from a track's reference point reaches HGCalNanoAOD's propagated HGCal entry within 0.23 cm (median; 1.3 cm for 90%) for high-purity tracks above 1 GeV; r = 295 cm is the inner radius of the coil.
